decisive_items: irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating and intermittently visible P waves in lead V1
Shows temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia with cycle length of 220 ms
response.rationale: Fontan-associated intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia is supported by an atrial-level tachycardia with variable AV block; adenosine-induced AV block without terminating the tachycardia excludes AVRT and favors an atrial reentrant mechanism.

rejected.why: AV reentry would be AV-node dependent and should terminate with adenosine, not continue through AV block.
Less specific than intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia, which is the characteristic Fontan-associated atrial arrhythmia.
Same AV-reentry mechanism as R1/R6; excluded by adenosine-induced AV block with ongoing tachycardia.
Atrial fibrillation would remain irregularly irregular and lacks the regular visible P waves and adenosine response seen here.
Too generic; supraventricular tachycardia is a category, not the specific Fontan-associated diagnosis.
Same AV-reentry mechanism as R1/R3; excluded by adenosine-induced AV block with ongoing tachycardia.
